# [NAME] Pratama Sitorus

Bandung, Indonesia · [EMAIL] · [PHONE] · [PROFILE]

## Summary

Marketing analyst moving into AI engineering. Three years of data work in digital marketing, followed by an intensive data science and AI bootcamp. Built LLM and retrieval projects end to end, from data preparation to a deployed API.

## Experience

**Digital Marketing Analyst**, PT Contoh Media Digital, Bandung · March 2023 - May 2026
- Wrote SQL queries in BigQuery to build weekly campaign performance reports for 12 brands.
- Automated report generation with Python scripts, cutting manual reporting time from 6 hours to 1 hour per week.
- Ran A/B tests for ad creatives and explained results to account managers.

**Marketing Executive**, CV Contoh Kreatif, Bandung · January 2021 - February 2023
- Managed social media campaigns and monthly budget reports in Excel.

## Education

**Data Science and AI Bootcamp**, Contoh Academy (online) · June 2026 - present
- Topics: machine learning, deep learning basics, LLM applications, MLOps with Docker and FastAPI.

**Bachelor of Communication (S1 Ilmu Komunikasi)**, Universitas Contoh Bandung · 2016 - 2020

## Projects

**Document Q&A Assistant (RAG)** · August 2026
- Built a retrieval-augmented chatbot over 40 PDF reports using LangChain, OpenAI embeddings, and a FAISS vector store.
- Served it with FastAPI in a Docker container; wrote an evaluation set of 30 questions to check answer accuracy.

**Customer Review Classifier** · July 2026
- Fine-tuned a small pretrained transformer (DistilBERT) with Hugging Face for 3-class sentiment; macro-F1 0.81.

**Campaign Budget Forecast** · 2025
- Forecasted monthly ad spend with Prophet for internal planning.

## Skills

Python, SQL (BigQuery, PostgreSQL), pandas, scikit-learn, LangChain, prompt engineering, FastAPI, Docker, Git, Hugging Face Transformers, Google Analytics, Looker Studio

## Certifications

- AWS Cloud Practitioner (course completed, 2026; exam not taken)

## Languages

Indonesian (native), English (professional working proficiency)
